queries.query: Write the repository AGENTS.md for this TypeScript workspace. Include the build and test commands, the package-scope rules, and pointers to the release procedure that an agent should read only for release work.

Review this AGENTS.md and tell me which facts belong inline, which should link to their owning documentation, and which generic or human-only material should be removed. Update the file without inventing new sections.
Migrate the existing AGENT.md to AGENTS.md and split the root and package instructions so each rule lives at the nearest scope that needs it. Keep commands current and leave a compatibility symlink.
Tighten the getting-started README prose and remove repetition while preserving every prerequisite and failure mode.
Rewrite the support assistant's system prompt so it keeps the purpose and payment constraints visible and retrieves the refund policy only when needed.
Review this TypeScript patch only for correctness, concurrency, and missing test coverage before merge.
Turn this operations runbook into a new Agent Skill with a role, description, scripts, references, eval plan, and complete lifecycle.
